Hey everyone! With thanksgiving coming up fast I am sure there are some of us here that are on dinner duty. I wanted to offer up some advice for those of you that are attempting to juggle everything through one oven.

Almost any BBQ that can fit a bird can be used in place of an oven for turkey cooking duty. I haven't done with with a gas grill before but charcoal has worked great for me time and time again. Everything is the same preparation wise. You just need to make sure to keep your charcoal piles off to the side and you will need to throw a few more briquettes in every once in a while to keep things going.

You will want piles of about 10-12 pieces of charcoal setup on each side of the bird.

Timing is very similar to an oven. The BBQ is also useful for cooking side dishes.. as long as they are covered it wont affect the flavor.
